video_title: HUGE Free Agents?? 10 Biggest Questions For The 2027 NBA Offseason

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Teams with significant cap space for 2027 free agency
quotes.excerpt: There's nine to ten teams that are sitting in a position to have money to go out

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: There's still nine to ten teams that are sitting in a position to have money to go out and spend.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: Brooklyn, of course, Chicago, teams that were in there already. There's some wild cards. The Hawks are one of those teams that have flexibility, and they don't have extendable guys. Basically, Cam Johnson is on an expiring, but of course, the big one's going to be Golden State.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's contract extension impact on Golden State's cap space
quotes.excerpt: If Curry extends for that number, which is a whopper, that's going to take away
quotes.quote: If Stephen Curry extends for that number, which is a whopper, that's going to take away their flexibility. They're not going to have as much as they potentially could, even with Jimmy Butler and Josh Green coming off the books.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's contract opt-out and the Warriors' cap situation
quotes.excerpt: The Warriors came to Draymond Green and said, 'Why don't you opt out to give us some optionality?'
quotes.quote: The Warriors came to Draymond Green and said, 'Why don't you opt out to give us some optionality?' with LeBron James and whatever else. They ended up not getting anybody, and they resigned Draymond right into the contract that he was already in. If Stephen Curry and the Warriors can't trust each other, who can trust anybody?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Draymond Green's trade kicker and contract situation with the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Draymond waived what would have been an implicit no-trade clause because it was a one-year deal
quotes.quote: Draymond Green waived what would have been an implicit no-trade clause because it was a one-year deal, but would receive a 15% trade kicker. So I guess Draymond's basically saying, 'Hey, if you want to move me, that's fine, give me the 15% kicker,' because for him, what's the use of holding up a trade if they're looking to get off him and he's going to be expiring anyway?

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: The rarity of no-trade clauses in modern NBA contracts
quotes.excerpt: We have one, Damian Lillard. Damian is the last man standing.
quotes.quote: We have one, Damian Lillard. Damian is the last man standing. At one time we had Bradley Beal, LeBron James, Stephen Curry. Yeah, Damian is the last man standing, but they don't exist anymore. Teams don't give those out.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic's contract strategy and future earnings
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokic is basically, this is the second summer in a row he's done it.
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokic is basically, this is the second summer in a row he's done it. He was eligible last year for three years. He decided not to do it, and he said he wanted to wait until the summer of 2026 because he can get a fourth year, an extra 70-80 million dollars. We get to this summer now, and he's saying, 'Well, I want to wait until the summer of 2027 because now I can get a five-year deal worth 360 million dollars.' So it's an extra 80 million dollars. The Nuggets didn't really do much in the off-season add. Peyton Watson's kind of still out there and everything, but I would not want that over my head.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Nuggets' luxury tax spending and commitment to their core
quotes.excerpt: It's not a coincidence that the Nuggets are diving deep, deep, deep, deeper than they ever have
quotes.quote: It's not a coincidence that the Nuggets are diving deep, deep, deep, deeper than they ever have into the luxury tax right now, that they basically just paid, what was it, Bobby, like 38 million dollars to keep Kentavious Caldwell-Pope? They are at least bluffing that they're not going to be looking to dump Kentavious Caldwell-Pope or Christian Braun, which the widespread belief was that they would in order to be positioned to keep Peyton Watson.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' contract status and trade eligibility
quotes.excerpt: He's got another year with a player option around 60. It's the year after that's the one
quotes.quote: He's got another year with a player option around 60. It's the year after that's the one to circle, because you've got Jalen Brunson. I hate taking a discount. So you got that, you got OG, you got Bridges, Josh Hart's extension is eligible too. He's got a team option next year. Yeah, I mean that's the, as you've said, Brian, it's like, you know, the hard thing is to win it, and then the other part is to keep it together. And that's that's it. You basically are going to have to have guys continually to take to take sacrifice here, but he's one of, you know, Anthony Davis in Washington, you know, same thing. He's got player options.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Wizards' aggressive roster moves and interest in DeMar DeRozan
quotes.excerpt: Shams caused me to stutter a couple days ago when he reported the Wizards were knocking
quotes.quote: Shams caused me to stutter a couple days ago when he reported the Wizards were knocking on DeMar DeRozan's door just to check in there. I don't know how likely that is, their roster is full, but you know, they went out and traded for Deandre Ayton, they went out and signed Chris Middleton paid significantly more than the minimum to get Chris Middleton, and I don't know how much he's going to contribute, but they just want him there as an option.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of the second apron on team roster building
quotes.excerpt: Listen, the apron's going to be, you know, the apron's coming back. We don't think it's going
quotes.quote: Listen, the apron's going to be, you know, the apron's coming back. We don't think it's going anywhere. That thing ain't going anywhere.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The complexity of NBA draft pick swaps and protections
quotes.excerpt: This has got to be the most confusing batch of picks ever. I just want to read
quotes.quote: This has got to be the most confusing batch of picks ever. I just want to read, Jeremy Woo gave a little assessment for us. Several of the big names in this draft are big names in college, new players to college in 26-27, are guys who have to play two years because of the age limit. Guys who we talked about this a few weeks ago. The draft itself, the players, Jeremy Woo gave a little assessment for us. Several of the big names in this draft are big names in college, new players to college in 26-27, are guys who have to play two years because of the age limit. Guys who we talked about this a few weeks ago.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Hawks' trade with the Pelicans and draft pick acquisition
quotes.excerpt: We know that Atlanta made that deal with New Orleans, and they ended up getting the eighth
quotes.quote: We know that Atlanta made that deal with New Orleans, and they ended up getting the eighth pick in this year's draft, which they drafted Kingston Flemings. So they have another interesting, they they owe their pick to San Antonio, but they have another interesting situation in this draft.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA's plans for international games in Doha
quotes.excerpt: The NBA was planning on having games in Doha this fall. I believe the Wizards and Nets
quotes.quote: The NBA was planning on having games in Doha this fall. I believe the Wizards and Nets were planning on going there, and possibly even the Cavs. The Cavs and Heat were looking at going to Abu Dhabi, and then going to Doha, but the Wizards and Nets were going to Doha. Those were, they never were announced, and a few days ago, the NBA decided to just move on from that obviously because of the situation in the Middle East.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Scotty Barnes' potential for Team USA selection
quotes.excerpt: One, Scotty Barnes, absolutely. Two-way player, great size, can hit the outside shot, defends.
quotes.quote: One, Scotty Barnes, absolutely. Two-way player, great size, can hit the outside shot, defends. Definitely a guy I think will get invited to the World Cup team. Same with Tyrese Haliburton.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaden McDaniels' defensive performance and Team USA prospects
quotes.excerpt: Jaden McDaniels. Now, the big problem, and not I'm not, I don't care so much about the World Cup
quotes.quote: Jaden McDaniels. Now, the big problem, and not I'm not, I don't care so much about the World Cup in 27, I mean, it's a it's a good event that you learn a lot at. I I care, I've covered three World Cups, trust me, I care, but like, I don't care so much about the US's performance. But when you look at the 28 Olympics, you're looking at the French, who have played the US in the final the last two Olympics. And you're looking at Victor Wembanyama, and you're wondering about Victor and how you're going to handle that. Well, Jaden McDaniels had some moments against Victor in the playoffs this year. Cram mentioned him, and I think he's a candidate too, Bobby. But also, you know, Chris Paul was that way too, and Chris Paul won multiple gold medals, so it's not an ironclad rule. I would agree that if Jaden Brunson wants to play, that that'll be the case.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's performance in the 2023 World Cup
quotes.excerpt: Brunson played on the 2023 World Cup team and was not particularly effective.
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson played on the 2023 World Cup team and was not particularly effective. Players that are undersized and defensively challenged are not something Team USA typically looks to. Having said that, he's undersized and defensively challenged in the NBA and just won the Finals MVP. So, I seem to remember that performance of him managing Victor quite well in that situation.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' potential participation in the 2028 Olympics
quotes.excerpt: If LeBron wants to play, he'll get a roster spot, quite frankly.
quotes.quote: If LeBron James wants to play, he'll get a roster spot, quite frankly.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James' commitment to playing for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron has said, in November on his podcast, 'Don't even ask, I'll be watching from Cabo.'
quotes.quote: LeBron James has said, in November on his podcast, 'Don't even ask, I'll be watching from Cabo.' But he just made it very clear, he plans to play at least two years for Philly. And if he's going to have his career end with the 27-28 NBA season, why not go out with a fifth Olympics? He's got a place in LA, doesn't even have to stay in a hotel, you know.
